name: Farasis Energy (Gan Zhou) Co., Ltd.
summary: Farasis Energy (Gan Zhou) Co., Ltd. provides energy solutions. The company is also engaged in the research, development, production, and sales of power batteries and battery systems; green power for transportation networks; as well as develops energy storage technologies. It is also involved in electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing; technology promotion and application services; sells new energy vehicle; and automobile manufacturing; as well as holds investments, and property. Farasis Energy (Gan Zhou) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Ganzhou, China.
